item.title: Innovation at the Crossroads: Technology, Institutions, and Societal Transformation in Times of Systemic Uncertainty
item.content:encoded:
This special issue examines how technological innovation intersects with institutional structures and drives broader societal transformation, particularly amid periods of systemic uncertainty. The collection seeks to understand the complex relationships between technological advancement, institutional adaptation, and social change.

Appel publié par Technology in Society. Voir l'appel sur le site de l'éditeur. Fiche de l'appel sur kerostig.
